summary: The session focuses on the importance of data governance, particularly in relation to AI governance and managing unstructured data. It emphasizes aligning data governance with business value and utilizing a federated governance model to enhance organizational effectiveness. The speaker also discusses the necessity of tools for effective governance and the integration of metadata across structured and unstructured data.

key_points: Data governance is about defining decision rights and accountability frameworks.
There is a disconnect between technology and business leaders regarding data governance.
Align data governance with business value to engage stakeholders.
Use a hub and spoke model to enable adaptive governance.
AI governance is becoming increasingly important and should be integrated with data governance.
Managing metadata for unstructured data is crucial for building knowledge graphs.

key_takeaways: Align data governance with business value and avoid discussing governance as a standalone topic.
Implement a federated governance model to support diverse organizational needs.
Capitalize on the opportunity to redefine data governance in the context of AI.
Prioritize the integration of metadata for both structured and unstructured data.
Utilize appropriate tools to enhance governance capabilities and align them with specific use cases.
